'''Honied French toast''' is the meal of [[Honey|honey]]. It heals {{Hp|10}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} II for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/honied_french_toast.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle, an egg, sugar, estus ash and bread (or naan). Picking up a honey bottle unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 1.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|10}} and gives Speed II (+40% speed) for 3:00.

=== Trading ===
It is one of the foods a villager can ask for as its [[favorite food]].
